# StudyX

> > StudyX is an all-in-one AI study platform offering homework help, note-taking, flashcard generation, and academic integrity tools powered by GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini.

StudyX provides students with free and premium AI-powered tools for learning, including homework assistance, content summarization, quiz generation, and writing analysis. The platform is accessible via web, mobile app, browser extension, and Discord community.

## Key Topics

- AI Homework Helper
- Note-Taking & Summarization
- Flashcard Generation
- Quiz Generator
- AI Detection
- Plagiarism Checking
- AI Humanizer
- Text Paraphrasing
- Multi-Subject Support
- GPT-4o & Claude Models
- Student Productivity
- Academic Integrity
- Free Study Tools
- AI Tutoring
- Test Preparation

## Core Study Tools

- [AI Homework Helper](https://studyx.ai/ai-homework-helper): AI homework helper with step-by-step solutions using GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini models.
- [AI Note Taker](https://studyx.ai/ai-note-taker): AI note taker generates organized notes from textbooks, videos, slides in seconds.
- [AI Lecture Note Taker](https://studyx.ai/ai-lecture-note-taker): Converts lectures (audio, video, transcripts) into organized notes in 30 seconds.
- [AI PDF Summarizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-pdf-summarizer): Generates full notes from uploaded PDFs in under 30 seconds.
- [AI Video Summarizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-video-summarizer): Creates organized notes from YouTube videos in 30 seconds.
- [AI Flashcard Maker](https://studyx.ai/ai-flashcard-maker): AI flashcard generator creates study cards from notes, PDFs, images for exam prep.
- [AI Quiz Generator](https://studyx.ai/ai-quiz-generator): Creates practice tests for AP, SAT, college exams with instant feedback.

## Writing & Academic Integrity Tools

- [AI Detector](https://studyx.ai/ai-detector): Checks if text is AI-generated by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini without login.
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://studyx.ai/plagiarism-checker): Scans writing for matching sources and originality before submission.
- [AI Humanizer](https://studyx.ai/ai-humanizer): Rewrites AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing instantly.
- [AI Paraphraser](https://studyx.ai/ai-paraphraser): Rewrites text with improved clarity while preserving original meaning.
